description.text: After months of searching for a sailboat that had retired from its days on the water, we found this beauty sitting by herself at Lake Hefner in Oklahoma City. We adopted her and brought her to float in the center of the Sailor & the Dock market collective.

targetApplicants.text: Test your knowledge, compete for glory, and enjoy a night of fun every month! Each trivia night has a unique theme designed to challenge and entertain. Gather your friends, form your teams, and see who comes out on top! 📅2026 Monthly Themes November — Thanksgiving Food Trivia Night 🫶 December — Year-End / General Knowledge Trivia 🥂 ✨ Bring your friends, put your knowledge to the test, and make every month a night to remember!

Anchoring a collective of creative local retail businesses, food & beverage concepts, an event space, and a sailboat bar that floats in the center of the venue – there’s something for everyone! Shop The Dock The Dock market is where unique local shops anchor their business. These creative concept and experiences surround an actual sailboat (which is a bar!), floating in the center of the venue. Expect a melting pot of local businesses featuring creative eats & drinks, coffee, trendy mission-driven retail concepts, and more.
